calibration.cell_success: any target-group feature p <= alpha/(H*60); standalone PSI or KS; single-block endpoint
calibration.global_rule: smallest grid n satisfying that same condition for every historically supported group, using the same calibration cells
calibration.group_family: same 30 named ACS groups as approved revision3 config
calibration.interval: lower endpoint of pointwise two-sided 95% Wilson
calibration.selection_rule: smallest grid n with minimum Wilson lower across both methods and both design alternatives >=.8 at pseudo-reference n=400
calibration.validation_rule: report independent validation pass/fail; never retune or silently remove a failed group
calibration.validation_targets: per-group target and global target only; deduplicate equal sizes without extra repetitions

compute.resume: completed cells bound to immutable config, source and code hashes; mismatches refused
compute.stopping: stop at cap or readiness/freeze deadline; preserve incomplete cells, never silently change design

contribution: Prospective empirical sensitivity/collection trade-off investigation; no new algorithm or promised PSI advantage established

evaluation.legacy_substitution: retain original Version 3 result/diagnostic unchanged; not an additional tuning or new evaluation cell
evaluation.outcomes: retained in whole rows but never read for target selection or collection
evaluation.pairing: same reference/base delivery and record membership across conditions and policies; statistic pairs share blocks
evaluation.sampling: conditional independent draws with replacement from one 2016 empirical pool; each post-onset target draw is resampled whole from its same-group weighted source

monitoring.cap: 800 is a target cap; whole-batch overshoot allowed and recorded
monitoring.collection: whole batches, count-only triggers; maximum wait 20 looks, unfinished blocks reported
monitoring.ks: Preserve exact KS plus missingness factor two, ties and warning=>p=1 safeguard
monitoring.multiple_testing: Holm over each fixed family at alpha/20 per look; no reset/recycling

randomization.stream_definition: SeedSequence integers [base_seed,stage,cell_index,repeat,channel]; ordered cell inventory and channels frozen before any run

role_split: r4-calibration-20261011|year:SERIALNO; first unsigned 64 hash bits <2**63 selection, otherwise validation

sources.calibration: 2015 ACS MA, previously reserved calibration role; lowest eligible SPORDER per household
sources.evaluation: 2016 ACS reference-role household pool, reused from Version 3
sources.natural: Preserve ACS 2016 vs 2017-2019; corrected BBB OULAD 2013J vs 2014J; descriptive

uncertainty.proportions: 95% Wilson; conditional Monte Carlo, not survey inference
uncertainty.resampling_unit: complete paired stream, stratified by condition; all policies/statistics remain paired
uncertainty.zero_width: identical observed paired endpoints, not universal equivalence
